text: Y'all check out the new update on how to access Seedance 2.0 it's working.
content: Select Seedance 2.0 Pro → Image to Video → set duration to 5s → set resolution to 720p to get Seedance 2.0 working.

extra_content.quoted_text: @MustafyOf Oh wow that worked. For me I had to do: Seedance 2.0 Pro, Image to Video, 5s, 720p https://t.co/orNMXLEYVw
